3d-obj.title: Image to STL & Layered 3D Converter | Genesis Image Tools
3d-obj.description: Turn flat PNG and JPG artwork into layered 3D models in your browser. Preview print dimensions and export per-layer STL, OBJ or Bambu 3MF files.

logo.title: Logo to 3D & Bambu 3MF Converter | Genesis Image Tools
logo.description: Build layered 3D logos from images, SVG or text presets. Check model size and filament layers, then export a Bambu 3MF project or per-layer STL files.

raster.title: Resize & Convert Images Online | Genesis Image Tools
raster.description: Resize and convert images in your browser. Open PNG, JPG, WebP or HEIC images, adjust your image and download the result without signing in.

bulk.title: Batch Image Converter & Resizer | Genesis Image Tools
bulk.description: Convert and resize multiple images in your browser. Prepare a batch of image exports with Genesis Image Tools, without signing in.

pdf.title: PDF to Images & Images to PDF | Genesis Image Tools
pdf.description: Save PDF pages as JPG, PNG or WebP, combine PDFs, or turn images into a PDF. Use the browser-based PDF tools without signing in.

annotate.title: Annotate Images Online | Genesis Image Tools
annotate.description: Open an image and add annotations in your browser. Mark up screenshots and visual feedback with Genesis Image Tools, without signing in.
